name: Alice

gender_note.quote: the hot day made her feel very sleepy and stupid

base_age_note.reason: Source gives no number; H1 ruling 5.6 A and CHAR-alice index entry fix 'about ten'. Base look is the waking-frame girl of Friday 4 July 1862; she keeps this same look throughout the dream (size changes are SUP-003 staging, not age changes).

hair.style: worn loose with a centre parting, straight to softly waved, no ringlets, no hairband; stray strands keep falling across her eyes and she tosses her head to clear them
hair.length: long, past the shoulder blades, slightly overgrown
hair.quote: mine doesn’t go in ringlets at all / Your hair wants cutting / that queer little toss of her head to keep back the wandering hair that _would_ always get into her eyes
hair.reason: Texture, length and behaviour are sourced; the colour is not stated and follows the user style reference refs/style/alice.jpeg (long brown hair).

eyes.quote: the bright eager eyes were looking up into hers
eyes.reason: Brightness/eagerness is sourced; colour not stated, chosen as a common English colouring that reads clearly against the brown hair and blue dress, and shared with CHAR-alice-sister as a family trait.

skin.tone: fair, lightly sun-flushed cheeks from a hot July afternoon outdoors
skin.reason: Not described; upper-middle-class English child of 1862 on a hot summer day (ch001-p02 'the hot day').

features: straight brows a shade darker than the hair
face.default_expression: curious, frank, slightly impatient; chin lifts when she stands up to authority
face.reason: Face shape/features not described; expression follows her conduct (ch008-p19 'very loudly and decidedly'; CUL-002 'chin up, without groveling').

build.scale_reference: ANCHOR for all character scale notes in this batch: Alice at her true size = 135 cm. Every size beat (ten inches, two feet, nine feet, 'a mile high') is SUP-003 forced perspective / scaled sets relative to this anchor, never a change to this card.
build.quote: once again the tiny hands were clasped upon her knee
build.reason: Height not stated; typical height of a well-fed English girl of about ten; 'tiny hands' sourced.

marks.description: the toss of the head to clear hair from her eyes — her recognisable gesture
a small box of comfits and her thimble live in her pocket

default_outfit_tone.summary: pale cornflower-blue cotton summer day dress with short puffed sleeves and a full skirt to just below the knee over petticoats, a plain white cotton pinafore apron with a front pocket over it, white stockings, black flat ankle-strap shoes
default_outfit_tone.silhouette_1862: child's crinoline-era bell skirt (petticoats, no hoop), short sleeves, rounded neckline; the white pinafore reads as a work apron, which is why the White Rabbit mistakes her for his housemaid
default_outfit_tone.quote: she tipped over the jury-box with the edge of her skirt / she put her hand in her pocket
default_outfit_tone.reason: Skirt and pocket are sourced; blue dress + white pinafore follows the user style reference refs/style/alice.jpeg. Full costume breakdown belongs to 06-art/costume (Phase 4).
